summary.text: Orlando Scott is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 162 in the November 3, 2026 general election, and Ballotpedia lists no other candidate for the seat.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as district manager and says he earned a bachelor's degree from Savannah State University in 1995.

paragraphs.text: Orlando Scott was born in Savannah, Georgia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Savannah State University in 1995, according to Ballotpedia.
The site lists his profession as district manager.
Scott ran for Georgia State Senate District 2 in 2022 and lost the Democratic primary to Derek Mallow, receiving 34.2 percent of the vote.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he listed support for full Medicaid expansion in Georgia, fair voting rights for all Georgians and reinvestment in youth as his key messages, and named public safety as an area of policy interest.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 162 on May 19, 2026.
